sentences.text: Badistornis aramus is the sole species within the genus Badistornis, a bird belonging to the family Aramidae.
This extinct bird resembles the modern limpkin but possessed a larger body size.
Wetmore formally named the genus in 1940 based on fossils recovered from the Metamynodon zone river channel sandstone in South Dakota.
The animal lived between 33.9 and 23.04 million years ago during the Rupelian to Chattian stages.
